versions.guide:
Enter the cave

Go along the northern mountain slopes and find the entrance to the cave - that is the agreed meeting place.
versions.html:
Reaching meeting place

The meeting place is a cave in the northern part of the mountains. A man will wait for you there. He knows how to find the key to open the portal to Gipath.
